notes.title: Dungeon Divers now live!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

The full Dungeon Divers game is now live! Please enjoy the game, if you have any bugs go ahead and post them in the forums and let us know. There's a 10% discount until Sept 12th!

If you have a moment please leave us a review! It really helps people find the game. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1844790/Dungeon_Divers/

Thanks again for all your support and happy diving!

notes.title: Update #3
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Here's the patch notes for Prologue Update #3.

If you have any issues please make sure to post in the forums so we can address them quickly. 

Please wishlist the full game, it's out tomorrow as that helps out immensely! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1844790/Dungeon_Divers/


[h3]Additions:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Predictable Mode setting:[/b] You can now enable an optional mode that will make secret rooms more predictable and less Random (meaning way less possible 50/50 situations) 
[*] [b]New items:[/b] 6 new items can now be unlocked
[*] [b]New achievements:[/b] 2 new achievements that can be unlocked in prologue
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Various bugfixes
[/list]

Till next time, happy diving!

notes.title: Dungeon Divers Releases August 29th!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Just wanted to make a quick announcement that Dungeon Divers releases [b]August 29th at 9AM PST[/b]. 

We're really thrilled at the amount of fun everyone has had with the prologue and we can't wait to share what we have in store for post-launch. If you haven't already please wishlist the game below it really helps us!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1844790/Dungeon_Divers/

Thanks again for all your support and we can't wait to get it into your hands. 

Onward to release!

notes.title: Update #1
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Here's the patch notes for Prologue Update #1, if you have any issues please make sure to post in the forums so we can address them quickly. Thanks for all your wonderful feedback thus far. Please wishlist the full game as that helps out immensely! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1844790/Dungeon_Divers/

We're still set to release this month and we'll post an announcement with full release date soon!

[h3]New Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*] New intro page at the start of the secret book that explains the basics and contains navigation links to every secret room type
[*] Japanese Localization now available!
[/list]

[h3]Item Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Larger click zone
[*] Now will auto switch from selected active item after use if it has no more charges
[*] You can now see charges of all active items (not only selected)
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Multiple bug fixes and translation fixes
[/list]

Till next time, happy diving!

Happy Diving!

notes.title: Dungeon Divers Prologue is Live!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We're pleased to announce that Dungeon Divers Prologue is now live. As a reminder all progress from the prologue will carry over to the full game! Please be sure to leave a review on the prologue when you can and wishlist the full game as that really helps us get discovered by new gamers!

We'll be talking about the release date really soon!

Happy Diving!
